nativeCoverage.reviewWarning: Texas native review rows use Capitol Data Portal VTD-level 2024 General Election President-versus-U.S. Senate rows. Certified county result rows remain sourced from Texas SOS County.json. The VTD presidential rows aggregate to 11,404,528 votes, 15,854 above the SOS county certified-result package total of 11,388,674. Reconciliation shows the gap is primarily a write-in scope difference: VTD rows include 24,730 generic Write-In votes, while SOS certified county rows include 8,569 named declared write-in candidate votes. Use VTD rows as official local screening context rather than replacement certified totals.
